**Firefox:** click [`feedfilter.xpi`](https://github.com/Wiskers790/feedfilter/releases/latest/download/feedfilter.xpi) in Firefox and choose **Add**. It updates itself.

**Chrome, Edge, Brave:** download `feedfilter.zip` and unzip it, open `chrome://extensions`, turn on **Developer mode**, and drag the `feedfilter` folder onto the page.

The model (~450 MB) downloads once on first run.
